long_biography.plain_text:
Midcoast Energy made Dan Tutcher a prominent figure in American natural-gas transportation. He developed the Houston company’s gathering, processing and pipeline systems before Enbridge acquired it. At Enbridge he took responsibility for US transportation operations and helped widen a crude-oil pipeline partnership into a natural-gas network. The work involved integrating Texan gas assets into a larger cross-border group.

Tutcher subsequently founded Center Coast Capital Advisors to invest in energy-infrastructure securities. He owned an indirect stake in the firm and worked as a senior portfolio manager before Brookfield bought it and retained the Houston team. He stayed involved with the sector through Enbridge’s board until his retirement from that role. Beyond energy, he has served on Gulf Capital Bank’s board and chaired Houston’s Alley Theatre.
